description: Issues the official numbered TouristPads quote for a confirmed order and emails it with its PDF to the customer from info@touristpads.com. Returns the quote number, the total and the link where the customer confirms and pays.

after_hours_charge_agreed.description: Whether the customer agreed to the after-hours charge on this order.

apps_per_ipad.description: Apps or files we pre-install on each iPad (0 = none).

apps_per_phone.description: Apps or files we pre-install on each phone (0 = none).

items.description: What to rent. A stand is one line with its iPad (e.g. ipad-102-floorstand).

message.description: Anything else the customer wants us to know (venue, event, special requests).

steel_cable_locks.description: Add a steel cable lock for every table-stand unit.

name: request_quote
title: Issue the official quote
